locations.label: Complete functional profile
locations.purpose: Fresh Rust frontend, complete original goals, exact logical counterproof and actual native witness

notes: Use a fresh writable cwd outside the installed prefix, then run bin/creusot-profile. The unchanged CPG SDK must be importable.

This entrypoint reruns the complete fixed profile. For custom experiments, verify and extract runtime.cpgpkg.tar.gz with the original SDK and use the preserved profile-config.json and runtime_environment.py; only the declared profile is qualified.

Rust frontend, complete contracts, Rustup and retained cargo/rustc/std components, OCaml/Why3, Z3 and CVC5 are bundled. Host cc/linker and CRT development files are required for native witness linking.
The inner archive is verified before expansion and every native ELF is checked by original check_binary_runtime against actual current_target using the exact functional environment.

No network is needed for install/check. Original upstream Rust/solver binary containers were SHA-locked but may require online reacquisition for upstream reconstruction; independent M qualification is not claimed.
